explanation: The LEFT JOIN keeps every 2025 month and looks for the row whose month is exactly a year earlier. NL-13 had no orders in July or August 2024, so no row matches and revenue_prev_year_eur is missing there, not 0; September and October 2024 exist, so they match. An inner join would drop July and August, and the month before is what LAG gives, not this join.
